description: Ten complete benchmark files. Each entire file is one indivisible case; no paragraph splitting.

files.text:
These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Book me a window seat on the earliest flight from Bucharest to Vienna next Tuesday.

Please rename every file in the reports folder that ends in .tmp so that it ends in .bak instead.

Send Maria the slides from yesterday's meeting, but don't cc anyone from the sales team.

Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 9 a.m., and again an hour later if I haven't marked it done.

Order two large pizzas, one vegetarian and one with extra cheese, and have them delivered to the office.

Cancel all my meetings on Friday afternoon except the one with the investors.

Archive the emails from last quarter, but keep the ones that are flagged as important in the inbox.

Tom thinks the server crashed because of a memory leak, but I'm not convinced.

My manager told me that the project would be cancelled unless we found a sponsor.

Maria asked whether anyone had seen her keys.

I am frustrated by how many unrelated details I have to keep track of.

Which of these requests can be handled now, and which need clarification?

List the unresolved questions before taking any action.

These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

The landlord claims that the heating was fixed last week.

I heard that the conference might move online this year.

She promised she would send the documents by noon.

The flight was cancelled because of the storm, so we had to stay an extra night.

Since the API changed its rate limits, our nightly sync takes three times longer.

The plant died because I forgot to water it while I was on holiday.

We lost the client after the third missed deadline.

Prices went up, which is why I'm cancelling my subscription.

The new model is faster than the old one but uses twice as much memory.

This is the cheapest flight that still allows a checked bag.

These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Our team closed more tickets this sprint than in any previous sprint.

The blue jacket is just as warm as the black one, but it's lighter.

Paris is less expensive than London, though not by much.

If the temperature drops below zero, turn on the heating in the garage.

Unless I tell you otherwise, always reply to recruiters that I'm not interested.

Whenever a customer complains twice in the same week, escalate the ticket to a supervisor.

If the build passes and nobody objects within an hour, merge the pull request.

Only notify me about expenses over 500 euros, unless they come from the travel budget.

If it rains on Saturday, move the picnic to Sunday; if it rains both days, cancel it.

As soon as the shipment arrives, check that every box is sealed before you sign for it.

I feel overwhelmed, although I appreciate the help.

Which claims are certain, and which are merely possibilities or reported beliefs?

Explain the uncertainties without silently choosing one interpretation.

I prefer aisle seats, but on night flights I'd rather sit by the window.

Don't schedule anything before 10 a.m. on Mondays.

I'm allergic to peanuts, so please avoid any restaurant that can't guarantee a nut-free kitchen.

The hotel must be within walking distance of the conference centre and cost less than 150 euros a night.

My budget for the laptop is around 1,200 dollars, and it needs at least 16 gigabytes of memory.

I like spicy food, but my partner can't handle anything hotter than mild.

Sorry, I meant the 2023 report, not the 2024 one.

These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Ravi plans to buy a laptop next month. He has compared three models, but he has not placed an order. Has Ravi bought the laptop?

Every employee who handles customer data must complete privacy training. Ana is an employee and handles customer data. Has Ana completed the training?

If a payment exceeds 10,000 euros, a director must approve it before it is released. Payment P7 is for 12,500 euros and has been released. Was P7 necessarily approved by a director?

Lea told Omar that the server was offline. Omar did not verify the claim. Is the server definitely offline?

The backup runs every night unless maintenance mode is enabled. Maintenance mode was enabled last night. Did the backup run last night?

The application allows a user to download the dataset only if that user is registered. It allowed Niko to download the dataset. Is Niko registered?

Maria submitted the revised proposal on Monday. Leo forwarded it to Iris on Tuesday, and Iris archived it after reading it. Who archived the proposal?

Two sensors failed during the test, but neither was replaced. Did any failed sensor get replaced?

Every paper has at least one author. There is an author who wrote three papers. Is there an author who wrote at least one paper?

Alice did not promise to attend the meeting. Bob thinks she promised not to attend it. Did Alice promise to attend?

I am frustrated by how many unrelated details I have to keep track of.

List the unresolved questions before taking any action.

These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

The clinic may schedule an appointment only after a referral arrives. Eva’s referral arrived at 09:00, and her appointment was scheduled at 09:15. Did the referral arrive before the scheduling?

All invoices except I9 were paid. I9 was disputed. Is I9 paid?

At least one backup is stored off-site, and every off-site backup is encrypted. Are all backups encrypted?

A developer may merge a change into main only if two reviewers have approved it. Kim merged change C4 into main after two reviewers approved it. Was C4 approved by two reviewers?

Every room has a temperature sensor. Room 12’s sensor reported 31°C, but the dashboard displayed 28°C. What temperature did the sensor report?

Sam believes the package arrived on Friday. Tracking data shows that it arrived on Saturday. Did the package arrive on Friday?

If the red switch is on, the pump runs. If the pump runs, the alarm is armed. The red switch is on. Is the alarm armed?

The contract becomes valid only if both parties sign it. Alice signed it, but Bob has not. Is the contract valid?

If either database A or database B is unavailable, requests are routed to the cache. Database A is available, and database B’s status is unknown. Are requests definitely routed to the cache?

Jules gave Pat the key because Pat had locked the door. Did Pat give Jules the key?

These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

After Mina reviewed the report, she asked Tom to correct it. Tom corrected the report but did not resubmit it. Was the report resubmitted?

An order may be cancelled within 14 days. A custom-made order cannot be cancelled. Order O8 is custom-made. May O8 be cancelled?

Every lab result is reviewed by either a physician or a senior scientist. Result R2 was reviewed by Dana, who is a senior scientist. Was R2 reviewed by a physician?

Neither Alex nor Priya attended the meeting. Chris attended remotely. Who attended the meeting?

Each approved expense has a receipt. Expense E3 has a receipt, but its approval status is unknown. Is E3 approved?

If a device fails self-test, it must not be shipped. Device D4 passed self-test. Is D4 prohibited from being shipped?

One reviewer checked every section of the document. Another reviewer checked only the appendix. Did some reviewer check both the introduction and the appendix?

The release was scheduled for June, postponed to July, and finally cancelled. Is the release still scheduled for July?

Eva said that Noah had deleted the file, but the audit log shows that Noah only renamed it. Did the audit log show that Noah deleted the file?

If the service is overloaded, latency usually increases. Today latency increased, but we do not know whether the service was overloaded. Was the service definitely overloaded?

I feel overwhelmed, although I appreciate the help.

Explain the uncertainties without silently choosing one interpretation.

Hmm, I guess the test probably failed.

Maria opened the document. She corrected it.

John did not say that Maria failed.
